description: This file defines the GlobalProperty class in the OpenMRS medical record system. The class represents global configuration properties as key-value pairs stored in the database, with metadata such as description, datatype, and access privileges. It includes constructors, getters/setters, and methods for value handling, datatype management, and privilege control.

classes.name: GlobalProperty
classes.description: Represents a global configuration property in the OpenMRS system, stored as key-value pairs with additional metadata such as description, data type, and access privileges.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Returns the key of the global property.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets the key of the global property.

methods.name: getPropertyValue
methods.description: Returns the value of the global property.

methods.name: setPropertyValue
methods.description: Sets the value of the global property.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the global property.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the global property.

methods.name: getDatatypeClassname
methods.description: Returns the class name of the datatype associated with this property.

methods.name: setDatatypeClassname
methods.description: Sets the class name of the datatype.

methods.name: getDatatypeConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration string for the datatype.

methods.name: setDatatypeConfig
methods.description: Sets the datatype configuration string.

methods.name: getPreferredHandlerClassname
methods.description: Returns the class name of the preferred handler for this datatype.

methods.name: setPreferredHandlerClassname
methods.description: Sets the preferred handler class name.

methods.name: getHandlerConfig
methods.description: Returns the handler configuration string.

methods.name: setHandlerConfig
methods.description: Sets the handler configuration string.

methods.name: getChangedBy
methods.description: Returns the User who last changed the property.

methods.name: setChangedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who last changed the property.

methods.name: getDateChanged
methods.description: Returns the Date when the property was last changed.

methods.name: setDateChanged
methods.description: Sets the date when the property was last changed.

methods.name: getViewPrivilege
methods.description: Returns the Privilege required to view this property.

methods.name: setViewPrivilege
methods.description: Sets the Privilege required to view this property.

methods.name: getEditPrivilege
methods.description: Returns the Privilege required to edit this property.

methods.name: setEditPrivilege
methods.description: Sets the Privilege required to edit this property.

methods.name: getDeletePrivilege
methods.description: Returns the Privilege required to delete this property.

methods.name: setDeletePrivilege
methods.description: Sets the Privilege required to delete this property.
